reviews.title: No longer working on iPhone
reviews.text: I loved this app for a long time, but a few months ago an update caused it to start working, and I haven't been able to use it since. iPhone 15 user, so it's definitely an app issue.

reviews.title: Location required
reviews.text: Another cash grab. You can’t listen unless you sign up, can’t sign up without giving your location under the guise of “we need to know your accent”. I’m not interested in recording so you don’t need my location.  One’s location is not a def indicator of accent either. I live in a mid Atlantic city yet there are people from the south, the north, the Midwest, other countries and they all speak with their native accents yet they live here in my city. Bogus.

reviews.title: Useless: no audio
reviews.text:
This app produces no audio on my iPad, nor my iPhone, which makes the app useless.

The app's support link leads to a nonexistent page on the developers' website. (This is the link from the "App Support" button on the app's page in the Apple App Store.)

In case the developers read this review:

- I'm using Forvo Pronunciation version 4.2.2. No sound is produced when I click on the "Play" button for any word.
- In contrast, the website at forvo.com works fine: every "Play" button produces audio.
- My iPad Pro 12.9", 5th-generation, is running iPadOS 26.5.
- My iPhone 15 is running iOS 26.5.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: I don’t know why but the basic play button on a pronunciation word doesn’t do anything.  You press it, it goes around in circles and then stops.  No sound.  Surely this is the first thing that should be checked.  I’m on iOS 26.4 iPhone 17 pro

reviews.title: A great app, when it works
reviews.text: I love this app, but it seems to freeze constantly. 80% of the time I have to go to the website because the app freezes up. I’m lucky if I can get one look up before it freezes and if I paste something into the search or my phone autocorrects, forget it. Frozen. It’s a shame because it’s a great resource.

reviews.title: Can I give it less than 1 star?
reviews.text: Downloaded app, attempted to sign up, says that the United States is not a valid country.  Keeps glitching on the terms and conditions.  Good thing it’s only $2.99. Good riddance.

reviews.title: Does this even work on iPad?
reviews.text: I am unable to get this to open.  All I get is a blank page.  I am not able find any settings or instructions either.  Not at all user friendly.

reviews.title: Purchased but app is non responsive
reviews.text: Was setting up app and it froze. Eventually deleted app and downloaded again. Still frozen after signing in.

reviews.title: Buggy as anything. Unable to sign in or sign up.
reviews.text: Buggy as anything. Unable to sign in or sign up. Fix the app, why should people pay for it when it doesn’t work?

reviews.title: App unusable
reviews.text: I am unable to search for anything without being logged in, but I get a blank screen every time I login.

reviews.title: Crashes and won’t post recordings
reviews.text: Using iOS 26, the app crashes frequently and will not accept recordings I’ve made using the app.

reviews.title: The system always crushes
reviews.text: Whenever I type in anything, anything, the system automatically crashes. And it repeated over a dozen times. I simply cannot do anything with this app!!!

reviews.title: Terrible app
reviews.text: I would not download this app. It freezes every time you open it and there is no way to fix it
